report_comment.text: CRTC3 encodes a coactivator of CREB-dependent transcription. MAML2 encodes a transcriptional coactivator in Notch signaling. CRTC3::MAML2 is a recurrent fusion in salivary mucoepidermoid carcinoma, joining a CRTC3 amino-terminal region to the MAML2 carboxy-terminal region. In a153-patient salivary mucoepidermoid carcinoma cohort, CRTC1/3::MAML2 fusion positivity was associated with better overall survival in the total and advanced-stage groups, with no observed disease-free-survival benefit.
